data.description: When a carrion golem is created, its creator infects it with a specific disease.  The carrion golem can then inflict those it strikes with its slams with this disease - most carrion golems inflict filth fever.  Filth Fever: Slam - injury; save Fortitude DC %1; onset 1d3 days; frequency 1/day; effect 1d3 Dex damage and 1d3 Con damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.
data.name: Plague Carrier
